sources.entry: An office suite is a collection of productivity software usually containing at least a word processor, spreadsheet and a presentation program.

summary.name: List of office suites
summary.one_liner: A Wikipedia list of office productivity suites, grouped into free/open source, freeware/proprietary, and discontinued titles, with the platforms each runs on.

Checking which office suites run on Linux or macOS
Comparing office suites by platform support
Looking up open source options for public sector or self-hosting
summary.what_it_does: The page defines an office suite as productivity software usually including a word processor, spreadsheet and presentation program. It lists free and open source suites such as LibreOffice, Apache OpenOffice, Calligra, OnlyOffice, Collabora Online and Nextcloud, with the platforms each supports. It lists freeware and proprietary suites including Microsoft Office/365, Google Workspace, WPS Office, SoftMaker Office, iWork and Zoho. A third section lists discontinued suites such as Lotus SmartSuite, Lotus Symphony, Microsoft Works, AppleWorks and StarOffice, with short notes on some.
notable: Covers free and open source, freeware and proprietary, and discontinued office suites in one list
Lists platform availability for each suite, including unofficial ports to BSD, Haiku and Solaris
Includes historical suites such as Lotus SmartSuite, Microsoft Works and IBM Works for OS/2
caveats: Discontinued suites are listed for reference and are no longer available
Pricing is not stated on the page; it is a list, not a comparison of features or costs
